_readme: Starting policies for the strategy engine, all tunable. Scoring and learning are R6 (docs/research/R6_Learning_loop.md), adopted as defaults: per-reach rates, a log2 index against the trailing median of the last 20 same-format posts (only posts at least 7 days old), clipped at +/-2; composite S; win = S > 0; discounted Beta-Bernoulli Thompson sampling. Judging windows are R7 (docs/research/R7_Judging_windows.md). Mix and cadence are R2 inside the spec's planning rules (4-5 feed posts a week, one sales post a week; spec p.34). Offer rules are R4 corrected by docs/research/REVIEW.md (Numa's facts win). Thresholds marked 'heuristic (R6)' are reasoned starting settings: re-check them against Numa's own data after a quarter. Planning rules (shoot_card.py check) and brand.json always override these numbers.

rules: Frequency: offer-led feed posts about 15-20% of the feed (2-3 a month), never more than one sales post a week (R4 rule 1, moderate; spec p.34).
Timing: the first week of the month and around paydays (days 1-5 and 14-16), or the last week for 'next month' (R2 measured for spending, low for Instagram; R4 rule 2 anecdotal).
Formats: lead with a carousel or a Reel; single photos only as reminders; a permanent 'New here?' Story highlight (R4 rule 3, moderate).
Framing: the experience and reassurance first ('what your first visit looks like'), then the offer; never lead with a deal (R4 rule 4, moderate).
Deadlines and scarcity only when true at posting time; no reset countdowns, no 'only 3 spots left' (R4 rules 5-6, strong: FTC dark patterns).
No 'normally $X' unless it is a bona fide recent price (R4 rule 7, strong: 16 CFR 233.1).
Discover Numa ends on its own: one time, no commitment; say so instead of renewal terms (REVIEW.md overrides R4 rule 8).
No outcome promises and no before/after of bodies (R4 rule 10, strong; brand.json claims).
Testimonials: real members with a yes on record, experience only, comps disclosed (R4 rules 11-12, strong).
No engagement bait: no 'comment YES', no 'tag 3 friends' (R4 rule 13, moderate).
Only offers in brand.json offerings.offers; never invent an offer, code, paid boost or partnership; NEWBIE is never public (REVIEW.md).
Don't send new people to Saturday mornings (often full); point them to weekdays (REVIEW.md).
Nothing that invites people in on a closure day (spec p.34 rule 8).

scoring.rates: Every metric divided by reach (R6 section 2): sends, saves, follows, profile visits, link clicks per reach; watch-through = average watch time / length; carousels and images use views per reach instead of watch-through.
scoring.bookings: Bookings are reviewed monthly by campaign (UTM links, booking codes, 'how did you hear about us'), never per post (R6 section 3).

reel.best_early_metric: Skip rate + average watch time at 72 h; sends per reach second.
reel.how_to_verify: After 20 Reels, Spearman of the 72 h score against the 168 h score: rho >= 0.9 raise the weight to 0.8; rho < 0.7 lower it to 0.4. Count Reels gaining >25% views between day 7 and day 30 (evergreen).

evidence.notes: heuristic (R6): thresholds, the 0.97 discount, the 70/30 split and the 40% cap are reasoned starting settings. Owner priors count as 4 tries, research priors 1-2, so Numa's data leads after a few posts. data-led share = min(1, judged posts / 30) gates format changes (spec p.34 rule 10). Trial Reels learn in a trial-only pool; holiday-week, boosted and collab posts are scored but kept out of the posteriors and decisions; January wins must repeat in February-March before a promotion.
